# Task Review — Deterministic Project Knowledge Surfacing (adversarial)

Reviewed translation of `specs/plan.md` into `specs/execute.md` + `specs/tasks.json`. Four independent lens reviews (coverage, executability, integration graph, index alignment) were dispatched at parent model/effort and synthesized here; every Blocker/High claim was re-verified against the repository before inclusion. No edits were applied to any artifact other than this report.

**Verdict: NOT READY to execute as generated.** One Blocker and five Highs are execution-blocking. The dominant defect: the plan's single most load-bearing control — the §2.5 real-host inline-delivery stop gate that must pass **before** migration or user-data changes — exists in the plan, in execute.md's own rationale text, and in the slicing rules, but has **no owning task** in the graph; real-host execution first occurs at terminal task 6.2.2 (wave 9), after migration is built (wave 3) and wired to live user data via SessionStart (wave 5) and install/update (wave 6). Everything else is repairable translation detail: two cleanup-ordering inversions verified against actual `src/lib/knowledge.js` readers, one CLI-routing task scheduled before the commands it routes to exist, one undefined test harness, four wrong-document context anchors, and a set of RED-pairing and sizing gaps.

No Scope Change Required findings: `tasks.json` meta scope/out_of_bounds faithfully reflect `scope.md` and plan §6, and no task implies Out-of-Bounds work.

## 2. Coverage Summary

**Plan §5 verification signals (17):** 12 fully covered, 5 partial, 0 entirely missing.

| §5 signal | Status |
|---|---|
| Readable store resolution; Canonical records; Exact matching; Prompt delivery; Session deduplication; SessionStart policy; Search CLI; Migration; Concurrent migration; Native discovery retirement; Install/doctor/uninstall; Generated artifact | COVERED (typed criteria in 1.1.x, 1.2.x, 2.1.x, 3.1.x, 4.1.x, 4.2.x, 5.1.x, 5.2.x, 6.1.x) |
| Atomic registration | PARTIAL — concurrent-writers end state missing (finding 12) |
| Payload budgeting | PARTIAL — real-host half exists only at 6.2.2; Phase 1/4 placement violated (findings 1, 6) |
| Derived index | PARTIAL — direct version edit untested (finding 22) |
| Grandfathered exception reporting | PARTIAL — doctor covered; migration-output half missing (finding 20) |
| Real runtimes | PARTIAL — terminal-only placement breaks the Phase 1/4 gates; non-Git restart/uninstall/no-repo-files dropped from evidence contract (findings 1, 6, 25) |

**Phase gates:** Phase 1 Succeeds-when (c)/(d) and Phase 4's real-host clause are unrepresented at their required positions (findings 1, 6); Phase 3's executable non-Git gate is deferred to Phase 6 (finding 18). Phases 2, 5, 6 gates map correctly.

**scope.md Success Criteria:** all 20 appear in `meta.requirements_trace` with substantively correct task coverage; two trace-source inaccuracies (findings 32, 33). `meta.scope` in/out lists faithfully condense scope.md and plan §1–2 — no additions, narrowing, or reinterpretation. **Scope Change Required findings: none.**

**Out-of-Bounds violations: none.** No subtask's produces/criteria/context implies semantic search, daemons/databases, lifecycle CLI/UI, graduation/PR workflows, sharding/fallback delivery, auto-merging legacy records, or hand-edited `plugins/spectre-codex` (6.1.2 AC2 explicitly forbids the last). One Low fidelity nit in the out_of_bounds text itself (finding 34).

## 3. Index Alignment Summary

execute.md vs tasks.json: **PASS, character-exact**, on all four checked surfaces.

- **Document Manifest** — all five paths exist and match the orchestrator manifest (scope at `docs/tasks/main/concepts/scope.md` is correct; the feature folder has no scope.md and task_context.md declares the concepts path canonical). Absent PRD/UX matches.
- **Execution Summary counts** — 7 phases / 13 parents / 32 subtasks / 10 waves all verified by enumeration; matches `meta.coverage_summary`.
- **Parent Task Index** — all 13 id/title/subtask-list/predecessor/unblocks strings match tasks.json exactly, including every multi-value dependency string.
- **Wave Plan** — all 13 parents appear exactly once across waves 0–9; `after` edges agree with every declared predecessor. Caveat: waves are valid against *declared* predecessors but wrong against *actual* data dependencies in three places (findings 2, 3, 4), and the stop-gate wave is missing (finding 1).

Anchor audit: 96 subtask context entries (32 × 3), 17 requirements_trace sources, and produces/criteria file references all checked. Every file claimed to exist does exist, including all initially-suspicious ones (`test_load-knowledge.mjs`, `test_register-learning.mjs`, `bin/spectre-register`, `spectre-apply/SKILL.md` with `## Registry`/`## The Rule`, `recall-template.md`, `.agents/skills/verify-spectre/SKILL.md`, `src/pack.test.js`, `scripts/sync-codex.cjs`), and all symbol anchors resolve (`parseFrontmatter`, `updateRegistry`, `skillBaseDir`, `migrateAllTriggers`, `oldRegistryPath`, `buildKnowledgeOverrideBody`, `knowledgeRegistryHeader`, `ensureKnowledgeFiles`, `syncKnowledgeOverride`, `buildSessionStartOutput`, `syncProjectSkillsConfigured`, `installCodex`, `uninstallCodex`, `runDoctor`, `projectPaths`, `parseArgs`, `listRuntimeMjsFiles`, `removeStaleFiles`, `translate`). Problems: four wrong-document anchors (findings 7–9), one composite phantom heading and one mis-scoped criteria range in requirements_trace (findings 32–33), one loose anchor (finding 38), two unlabeled produced-later artifacts (finding 39), one ambiguous relative path (finding 40). Explicitly-new paths (`plugins/spectre/hooks/scripts/knowledge/`, `src/main.test.js`) are correctly labeled as new/produced.

Subtask-level `consumed_by` contradicts the parent graph in three places even though parent symmetry passes both directions: 2.2.2→3.1 (consumer before producer, finding 2), 3.2.2→4.2 (parallel, no edge, finding 3), 3.1.2→4.1 (parallel, no edge, finding 10). No orphaned outputs; every produced artifact has a consumer and every consumed artifact a producer.
